featured_reviews.name: Anil Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had the pleasure of visiting Desi Savory Restaurant in Bhayandar East, and I must say it was an excellent experience! I ordered their Aloo Paratha, and it was one of the best I’ve had in a long time. The paratha was soft, fresh, and perfectly stuffed with flavorful potato filling — crispy on the outside and full of authentic taste inside. It was served with curd, butter, and pickle, which made it even more delicious.

The service was quick and very polite — the staff made sure everything was served hot and on time. The restaurant has a clean, homely environment and gives a true desi food feeling. The quality of food and hygiene was impressive, and the prices were also very reasonable for the taste and portion size.

I really appreciate how they maintain both taste and presentation. It’s clear that they care about customer satisfaction.

If you’re in Bhayandar and craving good desi-style food or want a proper homemade meal experience, Desi Savory Restaurant is the place to go! I’ll definitely come back again to try their paneer dishes, thalis, and tiffin service.

Highly recommended for families, office-goers, and anyone who enjoys authentic Indian flavors.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much, Anil, for such a detailed and heartwarming review! 🙏✨ We’re truly delighted that you enjoyed our Aloo Paratha, service, and homely atmosphere. featured_reviews.name: Dubey Chandan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Farmhouse Sea N Sand is a wonderful getaway spot in Mumbai, perfect for a relaxing day out with family or friends. Located near the beach, it offers a calm and peaceful environment away from the city's hustle.

The place is well-maintained and clean, which immediately makes you feel comfortable. One of the best things about it is the lush greenery around, creating a soothing vibe. The swimming pool is spacious and clean, making it a great spot to unwind or have fun with kids.

Their food is another highlight – the menu offers a variety of delicious dishes, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian. The seafood, especially, is fresh and flavorful.

Farmhouse Sea N Sand also provides a cozy seating area near the beach, where you can enjoy the cool breeze and beautiful sunset views. It’s an ideal spot for photography lovers as the surroundings are quite scenic.

Overall, it’s a great place for a weekend escape or even a small celebration. The staff is friendly, and the service is quick. Whether you want to relax, enjoy good food, or spend quality time with loved ones, this place is worth visiting!

featured_reviews.name: GAVIN RODRIGUES
featured_reviews.review_text:
Frankly, I visited this restaurant after watching some reels on Instagram and the Google reviews.
I was very disappointed with the service. Anything we ordered took longer than expected to serve. The delay in service was applicable for beer and drinks too.
Even placing an order with the restaurant attendent was time-consuming.
We ordered fish and prawns. Prawns were good but quantity was less (just 5 pcs). In fish we ordered pomfret (it was not fresh).
We ordered draught beer and it has no fizz at all and it also tastes as it was mixed with water and served.
I lost my cool when we ordered a starter and it took more that 40 minutes to serve. I don't mind the delay, but the waiter has to atleast tell us that the order will take time to prepare.
It was a very disappointing experience, I am never gonna visit this restaurant again.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hi GAVIN,
A genuinely sorry for the experience you had with us. We've noted your concerns regarding the delays in service and the quality of the food and drinks. Immediate steps are being taken to address these issues, such as retraining our staff on timely communication with our guests and conducting a thorough review of our food preparation processes to ensure freshness. 

Regards, 
Team Farmhouse
